fullAnalysis: I approached Pinpoint #685 by testing each clue against possible connecting words. The five clues were "Time", "The Economist", "Cosmopolitan", "National Geographic", "Reader’s Digest". "Time" — Time fits the theme. "The Economist" — The Economist fits the theme. "Cosmopolitan" — Cosmopolitan fits the theme. "National Geographic" — National Geographic fits the theme. "Reader’s Digest" — Reader’s Digest fits the theme. Once I noticed that all five clues could follow or precede the same word or phrase, the answer became clear. The answer is "Magazines (with global readership / versions)" because it is the first reading that explains all five clues without forcing any of them.
